user_requirement: deliver an explicit callable and saveable/loadable 3D time-varying velocity field through velocity(x,y,z,t)->[u,v,w]
public_source_fact: the public OpenAI velocity-field visualization is only a qualitative correspondence target unless separately quantified
autonomous_design: ST052-M replay capsule packaging, live transform adapters, and repository delivery-accounting policy

evidence_scope_rules.workflow_exact_source_checkout_plus_reci: supports exact-source replay provenance for that workflow execution
evidence_scope_rules.builder_manifest_alone: does not authenticate the source_root Git HEAD and must not be treated as a standalone source-head certificate
evidence_scope_rules.uploaded_actions_candidate: is a reproducible workflow artifact, not by itself a live package-level parent evaluator or whole-child save/load capsule
evidence_scope_rules.candidate_validation_linkage: governed separately by open PR #622; this contract does not duplicate that seam
evidence_scope_rules.pde_failure: does not block honest callable velocity delivery, but no parent/static/temporal PDE receipt may be transferred to a transformed child without fresh validation

parent_runtime_ready_requires: deterministic live package path that reconstructs or loads the authenticated ST052-M parent without an unauthenticated external callable
immutable parent artifact/candidate identity bound to the evaluator
finite deterministic velocity replay after load
whole_child_velocity_export_ready_requir: temporal time-law identity when temporal child is selected
